summary: Iteration 2 validated all P0/P2/P3 review-fix items. 19/19 backend tests pass on the public preview URL. Removed endpoints (/api/attendance/checkin, /api/attendance/checkout, /api/office/regenerate-qr, /api/admin/snapshot/import) all return 404. /api/office no longer leaks qr_token. /api/admin/cards now returns only {members:[...]} with no office_qr/office_name. mobile_last10 is set on member create AND refreshed on PATCH mobile. Phone-login admin bypass (9849002111) returns an approved token instantly. Phone matcher resolves members via the new mobile_last10 indexed field. Bulk member import accepts 2 valid + reports 1 duplicate error. /api/admin/backup streams a tar.gz with manifest.json + per-collection files; /api/admin/restore in merge mode reports 0 inserted across all non-drift collections. /api/sms/test does not crash with Twilio disabled. Frontend smoke: all 7 listed routes (/presence, /muster, /admin/members, /admin/calendar, /admin/fleets, /whats-new, /admin/cards) render with the correct heading and no error widgets after admin token is set; /admin/cards renders only member QR cards (no office card), confirming the P0 fix end-to-end.

minor.issue: daily_content collection always reports 4 inserted because the app auto-seeds today's content during the test request between backup → restore. Not a bug, but the restore response would be confusing to operators expecting truly 0. Consider excluding daily_content from snapshot or skipping seeding when an active restore is in progress.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Either exclude daily_content from backup/restore counts, or skip its daily-seeding when a restore is in flight, so merge-mode restore reports a true 0-inserted state.
(Pre-existing) /app/backend/server.py is 4092 lines — past iteration_1 also flagged this; consider splitting into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: lifespan-based startup: backfill of mobile_last10 + index creation runs on app boot — clean.
Phone matcher uses last-10-digit index (mobile_last10). Indexed in users; the lookup is one keyed find_one — solid fix for the prior N regex scan.

Backup streams JSON-encoded chunks per collection into a single in-memory BytesIO tar.gz. For an existing ~5k row demo DB this is fine, but for >100k attendance rows the tar.gz buffer will balloon. Future enhancement: tempfile-backed stream + StreamingResponse.
/api/admin/cards intentionally trims fields with projection {id, full_name, rank, category, personal_qr} — good.
/api/office strips qr_token via dict.pop, and Twilio auth_token is masked — secrets boundary respected.
test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 confirmed working. Admin mobile is 9849002111 → phone-login auto-approves (verified).

Cleanup is in test_99_cleanup + per-test inline cleanup; verified members listing returns no TEST_iter2_* rows post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files now live under /app/backend/tests/: test_ishowedup_api.py (iter1, 21 legacy scenarios — note its test_06_regenerate_qr will FAIL on current server because /office/regenerate-qr is intentionally removed; keep it skipped or delete that test) and test_review_iter2.py (iter2, 19 review-fix scenarios — ALL pass). Recommended next run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_review_iter2.py -v`.
